downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.53.10。选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.53.10. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 新增内外盘通用的持仓“按方向合并”模式：汇总同方向仓位的总手数、加权均价和图表持仓线，国内期货同时显示今仓 / 昨仓，底层逐笔成交完整保留。
highlights.en: Added a cross-market “Merge by direction” view with total size, weighted average entry, and one chart position line. CN futures also show today / previous-day lots while preserving every underlying fill.

highlights.zh: 分批止盈止损支持按指定价格触发，并可按具体手数或持仓百分比退出；加仓、部分平仓或原锚点仓位退出后，剩余规则继续执行。
highlights.en: Staged take-profit and stop-loss rules can now trigger at exact prices and exit by lots or position percentage. Remaining rules continue after scaling, partial closes, or the original anchor exits.

highlights.zh: 合并持仓部分平仓会遵循不同市场的处理顺序；国内期货优先处理当前交易日仓位，再按时间处理较早仓位，并继续按原始逐笔持仓计算手续费和复盘数据。
highlights.en: Partial closes on merged positions now follow each market’s close order. CN futures close current-trading-day lots first, then older lots, while fees and replay data remain fill-accurate.

highlights.zh: 仓位下单后锁定对应交易系统，避免持仓期间误改；同一合并持仓包含不同系统或未关联系统时，会明确显示为未统一。
highlights.en: Trading-system assignment is now locked after entry to prevent accidental changes. Merged positions with mixed or missing system links are clearly shown as not unified.

highlights.zh: 国内期货“分时”可作为第一个常用快捷周期；10 个快捷周期上限会正确计入分时和自定义周期，删除自定义周期后也不会留下无效占位。
highlights.en: CN futures can now place intraday view first in the timeframe shortcuts. The 10-shortcut limit correctly counts intraday and custom periods, with no stale slots after a custom period is removed.

highlights.zh: 修复 2×2 四窗布局中只有左上窗口双击能正确最大化的问题；现在四个窗口均可双击铺满，并再次双击恢复原布局。
highlights.en: Fixed 2×2 chart layouts only maximising the top-left pane. Every pane can now be double-clicked to fill the workspace and double-clicked again to restore the grid.

highlights.zh: 修复统计与复盘日历的盈亏颜色没有跟随内盘 / 外盘市场颜色习惯切换的问题。
highlights.en: Fixed statistics and replay-calendar P&L colours not following the selected CN / global market convention.

highlights.zh: 修复账单历史交易展开复盘时，右上角交易系统选择器被布局压缩遮挡的问题。
highlights.en: Fixed the trading-system picker being compressed or hidden when opening statement-history trade review.

highlights.zh: 修复合并持仓包含不同进场笔记时，编辑内容无法同步到全部底层持仓的问题；现在会保留各笔原始笔记，并把合并视图中新写的内容同步到每一笔持仓。
highlights.en: Fixed merged-position note edits not reaching every underlying fill. Original per-entry notes are preserved, while new content added in the merged view syncs to each position.
